text:
Low Effort Zemouregal and Vorkath (HM)

​
Disclaimer
⬥ IF YOU CANNOT GET A METHOD TO WORK DO NOT MESSAGE THE CREATOR(S)
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It is more than likely user error or cutting corners, use #pvm-help if you cannot get it to work
​
Necromancy Low Effort Method (10-11 kph) 
Overview


















⬥ The following ARE REQUIRED for this method to work:
    • Cutting corners will result in failure
    • A more extensive list can be found in #unknown-channel

Items
⬥ Zemouregal's Nexus 
    • Deathwarden Nexus has not been tested and may not be as consistent
Perks
⬥ Robe top of the First Necromancer 
    • Ultimatums 4  + Crackling 4  
    • Equilibrium 4  + Undead Slayer 
⬥ Robe bottom of the First Necromancer 
    • Enhanced Devoted 4 
    • Lucky 6  + Absorbative 1 
⬥ Soulbound Lantern 
    • Precise 6  + Genocidal 
Abilities
⬥ Darkness 
⬥ Conjure Undead Army 
    • Have all 4 conjures selected
⬥ Greater Bone Shield 
Other
⬥ Tier 100 weapons 
    • Method has not been tested without and may not work
⬥ Hellhound 
⬥ Bonfire Boost  and Ogre flask (thermal) 
    • Wear HP boosting equipment.
    • Totem of Vitality preferred over Bonfire Boost 
⬥Tier 2 Malletops Perk 
⬥Blue Dragon/Dragon cluster slayer task
    • Undead cluster tasks also work but are not recommended
